# MathJax 3.2.2

Unmodified `es5/tex-svg.js` from the official `mathjax` npm package, downloaded from:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js

MathJax is Copyright (c) The MathJax Consortium and is distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The package's license is included in `LICENSE`.

This combined component includes the TeX parser, SVG output, and TeX font paths. Site configuration lives in `../../js/math-config.js`.
